answer: In a nebula haven, every identity must berth one raven courier, and the k-th berth costs the k-th pentagonal number of nebula shards: the first pays 1, the second 5, the third 12, the tenth 145, so ten identities pay 550. Only one raven may dock per hour, so the hundredth fake waits 99 hours, and its berth alone costs 14,950 shards, twenty-seven times the first ten pay.
